name: Network Plan
description: Plugin #3 (epic #1554, Phase 3): an editable team planning board — streams, milestones, owners and dependency lines — served from its own sidecar and proxied into the console through the §4.8 UI-extension stack (#1562). Replaces a hand-edited standalone HTML file whose status ticks lived only in the viewer's localStorage: here the board is one server-side document per team, so two people (or two browser profiles) see the same truth and every change is reviewable. The load-bearing decision is that statuses and requirement targets key on milestone ids, never array indices, so inserting or reordering a milestone shifts nothing else. Agent write access is configurable and off by default (settings.agentAutonomy 0/1/2, §8): agents read the board at level 0, tick milestones at level 1, and edit structure at level 2 — every write enforced broker-side and audited with the calling agent named. Agents drive it with the dependency-free `aee-plan` CLI (e.g. `aee-plan show`, `aee-plan tick <milestoneId>`).
promptLine: You can read — and, if the Team Admin has raised the autonomy level, tick or edit — the team's Network Plan board with `aee-plan` (run `aee-plan --help`). At the default autonomy level 0 you can only read the board; writes are refused until a human raises the level, and every write you make is audited under your agent id.
